hero.title: YOUR BOOKINGS.
hero.body: Bring requests, conversations and dates together in one place. Even when the first contact happens outside Cuebooker.
hero.note: For independent DJs, managers and agencies.
hero.signature: Keep the music moving. The booking is already happening.

problem.label: THE PROBLEM
problem.title: Your bookings are everywhere.
problem.body: A date changes on WhatsApp. Terms arrive by email. Cuebooker keeps the proposal and its follow-ups in one workspace.

entries.context: What you don’t want to forget

problem.capture: You capture the opportunity. Cuebooker keeps the thread.
problem.note: Instagram, WhatsApp and phone conversations are not imported automatically.

work.label: 01 / HOW IT WORKS
work.title: From proposal to confirmed date.
work.body: Capture what comes in, review the context and keep the next step in sight. You decide when to confirm.
descriptions: Add an opportunity that starts elsewhere or receive a request through your profile.
Review the date, terms and contact before moving forward.
Keep the next move and holds alongside the conversation.
Confirm when everything fits. The date stays in your calendar.
work.note: Illustrative example. No messages are sent and no bookings are created.
work.confirmed: 18 Oct · Booking confirmed in this example

seo.title: Cuebooker | Your bookings. Under control.

features.label: 02 / PRODUCT
features.title: The context, the next step and the date.
features.body: Your workspace organises the work. Commercial decisions stay yours.

items.title: Requests and conversations
items.text: Keep the contact, terms and history of each opportunity together in one booking.

items.title: Follow-ups and holds
items.text: Record the next move and hold a provisional date without treating it as a confirmation.

items.title: Calendar and availability
items.text: Review bookings, holds and private availability blocks before committing a date.
